_humanSelection: `human` is what scripts/check-headline-discriminator.ts reads. It is a SUBSET of
byArrangement, and the subset is experimental design rather than cherry-picking.
A held-out set has to be like-for-like with what the generator produces, or the
judge separates on task and grammar instead of on writing. Three exclusions, each
measured against the Folio checks in src/lib/posting/headline.ts:
1. Opens on a NAMED agent - 26 of 46 (57%). Folio bans naming the credited party
(NAMES_PEOPLE, enforced at write and on read), so it cannot produce this shape
at all. Leaving them in lets a judge score 'names a studio' = human and learn
2. Fails a Folio check - 35% exceed the 10-word max, 4 read as Title Case, 3 use
a banned generic verb (unveils, features, celebrate).
3. A different task - corpus-scope round-ups ('Eight kitchens that...') and news
items ('Construction begins on...'). The collector already noted round-ups are
What survives all three is 5 headlines. That is the script's bare floor and well
below the 20 it recommends, so a baseline computed on it will be noisy. The gap is
the one the collector flagged: publications that do not lead with the studio name.
